# Rule catalogue: yellow_taxi

<!-- Generated by `python src/quality/rule_catalogue.py` from configs/quality_rules.yml. Do not edit by hand. -->

20 rules: 12 quarantine and 7 warn enabled, 1 pending. Measured hit rates are in [rule_results.md](rule_results.md), written by `python src/quality/rule_catalogue.py --results`.

- **quarantine**: the row is moved to Quarantine with its reasons (Phase 4).
- **warn**: the row stays in Silver, flagged with its reasons.
- A rule only judges values that are present: empty values pass every rule except the
  completeness rules, so a missing value is reported once.
- Rules run on the standard schema (configs/datasets.yml), after standardization.

## Completeness

| Rule | A row passes when | Action | Severity | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `trip_metadata_missing` | not all of `passenger_count`, `RatecodeID`, `store_and_fwd_flag`, `congestion_surcharge`, `airport_fee` are empty | warn | low | Rows where the meter sent no trip metadata. Fares and zones are present, so the trip is real; one warning instead of five per-column failures. |
| `trip_times_present` | `tpep_pickup_datetime`, `tpep_dropoff_datetime` are filled | quarantine | high | Every later check and every Gold metric needs both timestamps. |

## Uniqueness

| Rule | A row passes when | Action | Severity | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `trip_unique` | first row with this `VendorID`, `tpep_pickup_datetime`, `tpep_dropoff_datetime`, `PULocationID`, `DOLocationID`, `fare_amount`, `total_amount` | quarantine | medium | The same trip delivered twice would be counted twice in every metric. |

## Validity

| Rule | A row passes when | Action | Severity | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fare_not_negative` | `fare_amount` ≥ 0 | quarantine | high | Negative fares are refunds and disputes: valid business records, but not trips. |
| `total_not_negative` | `total_amount` ≥ 0 | quarantine | high | Negative totals belong to the same refunds; checked separately in case the fare is positive. |
| `fare_not_zero` | `fare_amount` ≠ 0 | warn | low | A zero fare with a trip is unusual but can be a no-charge trip (payment_type 3). |
| `distance_not_negative` | `trip_distance` ≥ 0 | quarantine | high | A negative distance is physically impossible. |
| `distance_not_zero` | `trip_distance` ≠ 0 | warn | low | Often cancelled or flat-rate trips; kept in Silver but counted. |
| `distance_max_100_miles` | `trip_distance` ≤ 100 | quarantine | medium | Extremes up to 345,729 miles exist; above 100 miles a city taxi trip is not plausible. |
| `passengers_not_zero` | `passenger_count` ≠ 0 | warn | low | Driver-entered field; zero usually means it was not filled in. |
| `passengers_max_6` | `passenger_count` ≤ 6 | quarantine | medium | More than six passengers do not fit in a yellow taxi; the value is likely a typing error. |

## Pattern

| Rule | A row passes when | Action | Severity | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pickup_in_file_month` | `tpep_pickup_datetime` is inside the file's month | quarantine | high | Each monthly file should hold that month's trips; others signal a wrong or mixed delivery. |

## Referential

| Rule | A row passes when | Action | Severity | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pickup_zone_known` | `PULocationID` exists in lookup `taxi_zone.LocationID` | quarantine | high | Every pickup zone must exist in the zone lookup (referential integrity). |
| `dropoff_zone_known` | `DOLocationID` exists in lookup `taxi_zone.LocationID` | quarantine | high | Every dropoff zone must exist in the zone lookup (referential integrity). |
| `pickup_zone_not_unknown` | `PULocationID` is not 264, 265 | warn | low | Zones 264/265 are valid IDs without a real location (Unknown / Outside of NYC). |
| `dropoff_zone_not_unknown` | `DOLocationID` is not 264, 265 | warn | low | Zones 264/265 are valid IDs without a real location (Unknown / Outside of NYC). |

## Consistency

| Rule | A row passes when | Action | Severity | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dropoff_not_before_pickup` | `tpep_dropoff_datetime` ≥ `tpep_pickup_datetime` | quarantine | high | A trip cannot end before it starts. |
| `trip_has_duration` | `tpep_dropoff_datetime` ≠ `tpep_pickup_datetime` | warn | low | Dropoff equal to pickup usually means a test or cancelled meter start. |
| `trip_under_24_hours` | `tpep_pickup_datetime` to `tpep_dropoff_datetime` lasts at most 86,400 s | quarantine | medium | A taxi trip longer than a day is a meter or clock error. |
| `total_matches_parts` | `total_amount` = sum of `fare_amount`, `extra`, `mta_tax`, `tip_amount`, `tolls_amount`, `improvement_surcharge`, `congestion_surcharge`, `airport_fee`, or of `fare_amount`, `extra`, `mta_tax`, `tip_amount`, `tolls_amount`, `improvement_surcharge` (± 0.01) | quarantine (**pending**, disabled) | medium | The charged total should equal its components. Pending open item O1: the formula is being confirmed on the full data. |
